subject: general
question: The Indian Olympic Association is affiliated to ________.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**International Olympic Committee**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Indian Olympic Association** is officially affiliated to the **International Olympic Committee (IOC)**.
 
• The IOC is responsible for the** organization and oversight of the Olympic Games.**
 
• The IOC works with **National Olympic Committees, International Sports Federations**, and other organizations to promote Olympism worldwide.
 
• Being affiliated with the IOC allows the Indian Olympic Association to participate in the Olympic Games and have access to various programs and support from the IOC.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 IOC Fact
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Foundation**
 **IOC** was founded on 23 June 1894 in Paris, France, with the aim of promoting peace and unity through sports.
 
 

 **Olympic Charter**
 The guiding document for the Olympic Movement, outlining the fundamental principles and rules of the Olympic Games.
 
 

 **Headquarter**
 The IOC's headquarter is located in Lausanne, Switzerland since 1915.
 
 

 **Membership**
 Consists of National Olympic Committees, International Sports Federations, and IOC members who are representatives of the Olympic Movement.
 
 

 **Olympic Games**
 Organizes both the Summer and Winter Olympic Games, which are held every four years in different countries.
